chunks: The eminent Shaykh Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Musa ibn Babawayh al-Qummi (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us, saying: My father (may God have mercy on him) narrated to us, saying: Sa'd ibn Abdullah narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn Isa ibn Ubayd al-Yaqtini narrated to us, saying: Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman narrated to us, saying: al-Hasan ibn Ziyad al-Attar narrated to us, saying: Sa'd ibn Turayf narrated to us from al-Asbagh ibn Nubata, who said: Amir al-Mu'minin Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) said:

Learn knowledge, for surely learning it is a good deed, studying it is glorification, researching it is jihad, and teaching it to one who does not know it is charity. It is, before God, a means of nearness for its possessors, because it contains the markers of the permissible and the forbidden. It guides its seeker to the path of Paradise. It is a companion in loneliness, a friend in solitude, a weapon against enemies, and the adornment of friends.

Through it, God raises peoples and makes them leaders in goodness who are followed. Their deeds are admired, their sayings are quoted, and the angels desire their friendship, wiping them with their wings during their prayers. For knowledge is the life of hearts, the light of sight from blindness, and the strength of bodies from weakness. God settles its bearer in the stations of the righteous and grants him the company of the elect in this world and the Hereafter.

By knowledge, God is obeyed and worshipped; by knowledge, God is recognized and affirmed as One; by knowledge, family ties are maintained; and through it, the permissible and the forbidden are known. Knowledge is the leader of the intellect, and the intellect is its follower. God inspires it to the fortunate and deprives the wretched of it.

key_terms.أئمة: Leaders/guides - those who lead others in goodness
key_terms.تعلم: Learning/studying - the active pursuit of knowledge
key_terms.قربة: Means of nearness to God - a devotional act that brings one closer to the Divine
key_terms.مدارسة: Mutual study/revision - collaborative learning and discussion
key_terms.معالم الحلال والحرام: The markers of the permissible and forbidden - signposts of Islamic law

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say about the virtues and importance of seeking knowledge?
ai.summary: In this sermon from the Amali of Shaykh al-Saduq, delivered during a teaching session in 368 AH, Imam Ali (AS) delivers a comprehensive exhortation on the virtues of knowledge. He enumerates the spiritual rewards of learning, studying, researching, and teaching knowledge, then describes how knowledge elevates its possessors to become leaders admired by both humans and angels. The sermon reflects the early Islamic emphasis on knowledge as the foundation of all worship, morality, and social obligations.
